text: 9月2日，北京市副市长孙硕在北京证券交易所宣布设立五周年之际，调研北交所市场建设情况，并主持召开北京市服务企业上市专班工作会议，听取北京企业上市服务工作及上市公司发展情况，研究下一步工作。北京市金融管理局、市委网信办、市科委中关村管委会、市经济和信息化局、市国资委、市发展改革委、西城区、海淀区、经济技术开发区、北京证监局、北交所相关负责同志参加会议。（北交所发布）
text_en: On September 2, Beijing Vice Mayor Sun Shuo, on the occasion of the fifth anniversary of the Beijing Stock Exchange's establishment, surveyed the BSE market construction and chaired a Beijing service enterprise listing working group meeting, hearing updates on corporate listing services and listed company development in Beijing and studying next steps. Officials from the Beijing Financial Regulatory Bureau, Beijing Cyberspace Administration, Beijing Municipal Science & Technology Commission and Zhongguancun Administrative Committee, Beijing Municipal Bureau of Economy and Information Technology, Beijing SASAC, Beijing Municipal Development and Reform Commission, Xicheng District, Haidian District, Beijing Economic-Technological Development Area, Beijing CSRC bureau, and the Beijing Stock Exchange attended the meeting. (BSE release)
